description: Use this when exact details or provenance matter: when the user asks why the assistant believes something, or wants to see the source memories behind a reflection. Given a memory id from a search result, returns the lower-tier memories that reflection was built from, or, for a raw memory, which reflections it was consolidated into. Use repeatedly to drill down from a high-level reflection to the tier 2 reflections and raw memories beneath it. Read only.

memory_id.description: A memory id (UUID) from a search result or a previous inspect.

name: inspect_memory
title: Inspect memory lineage
